description.value: After attaining 19th level, a geomancer gains great power and manifests a portion of the raw energy of the universe within themselves. Choosing an elemental plane of existence, she becomes completely immune to all of that plane's negative effects as if native to it, and any spells that would be dampened because of the plane (Water spells in the Fire plane) are cast as normal spells. This ability can be switched, altering which plane the geomancer is acclimated to, every day, but cannot be changed after she makes her decision for the day.
